hit.next_experiment: Validate at PATHWAY level: test whether the ranked knockdowns recover this program's canonical regulators at both tails, in a second independently screened cell type, using set-level enrichment — not individual gene lookups.
hit.why_not_gene_level: Guide-pair concordance is -0.019. Two independent guides against the same gene give uncorrelated scores, so any single-gene call here is not reproducible. Set-level statistics aggregate over thousands of perturbations and survive that noise; individual ranks do not.
hit.what_would_change_my_mind: This program is called reversible because 5,707 knockdowns moved it. Two things would demote that, and both are measurable before anyone commits: (1) if a size-aware re-ranking (CAMERA-style, or a permutation null preserving set size) drops its residual below 0, the 5,707 hits were set size and not biology — its residual is currently -0.408; (2) if the canonical regulators of this program do NOT land at both tails in a second independently screened cell type at set level, the ranking is not recovering known biology and nothing here should be carried forward.
hit.caveat: Observed R_p is 0.41 below what measurability alone predicts. The measurability model explains most of the variance across programs, so the residual is the only part that can be biology.
hit.cost: existing RPE1 matrix; no new data.
